summary: Borderlands franchise entries added as supplemental sourced guide rows; Sami did not list these in the locked personal spine.

entries.title: Borderlands
entries.definitive_edition: Borderlands: Game of the Year Enhanced on Windows

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows Game of the Year Enhanced

primary.version: Borderlands: Game of the Year Enhanced
primary.why: The original Borderlands shipped on PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, Windows, and Mac, then received the Game of the Year Enhanced remaster on Windows, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and Switch-era packages. Windows Game of the Year Enhanced is the best archive route because it keeps the complete GOTY content while adding the remaster's improved models, environments, textures, and PC capture/settings ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Use Borderlands: Game of the Year Enhanced on Windows through Steam or Epic. Keep the original Windows release only for historical comparison or compatibility testing.

entries.remaster_caveats: Enhanced changes presentation and quality-of-life behavior; preserve the original PC release separately for historical comparison.

entries.title: Borderlands 2

primary.why: Borderlands 2 shipped first on PlayStation 3, Windows, and Xbox 360, then came to OS X, PlayStation Vita, Linux, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Nvidia Shield Android, and Nintendo Switch. Windows is the best main-run route because it has the highest capture/settings ceiling and access to the full DLC ecosystem without handheld or older-console compromises.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows version with all story DLC installed. Treat Borderlands 2 VR as a separate VR adaptation entry.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Handsome Collection is a convenient console bundle, but not the highest-fidelity archive route.

entries.title: Borderlands Legends

primary.why: Borderlands Legends was released for iOS devices as a mobile strategy spin-off. No modern official port is sourced, so the original iOS release is the archival route.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legitimately retained iOS install on compatible legacy hardware if available; otherwise preserve captures and metadata.

entries.remaster_caveats: Legacy mobile spin-off; availability may be limited by App Store delisting and old iOS compatibility.

entries.title: Borderlands 2 VR

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: High-end PC VR headset on Windows

primary.why: Borderlands 2 VR launched first on PlayStation VR and later came to Steam for PC VR headsets with the Bad Ass Mega Fun DLC Pack. Windows / SteamVR is the best archive route because it has the broadest headset/GPU ceiling and includes the free PC VR DLC expansion route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam version of Borderlands 2 VR on Windows with a supported PC VR headset and the free BAMF DLC installed.

entries.remaster_caveats: VR adaptation is single-player and should not replace the standard Borderlands 2 main-run entry.

entries.title: Tiny Tina's Assault on Dragon Keep: A Wonderlands One-Shot Adventure

primary.why: Tiny Tina's Assault on Dragon Keep began as Borderlands 2 DLC and later received a standalone One-Shot Adventure release for PC, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One. Windows is the best archive route because the standalone PC build has the highest capture/settings ceiling and does not require a Borderlands 2 campaign save.
primary.how_to_play: Use the standalone Windows release through Steam or Epic. Play the original DLC inside Borderlands 2 only if you want historical context for its original release state.

entries.remaster_caveats: Standalone release is based on the 2013 Borderlands 2 expansion; do not count it as a full new mainline Borderlands campaign.

entries.title: Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel

primary.version: Current PC release / Handsome Collection-era build
primary.why: The Pre-Sequel shipped on PlayStation 3, Windows, Xbox 360, Linux, OS X, Android Nvidia Shield, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch. Windows is the best archive route because it has the best capture/settings ceiling and the current PC build benefits from later update support including the 4K update noted alongside The Handsome Collection.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows version with DLC installed. Use The Handsome Collection console versions only when a console route is specifically needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Handsome Collection is a good console package but not the primary PC archive route.

entries.title: Tales from the Borderlands

primary.why: Tales from the Borderlands released episodically across Windows, PlayStation, Xbox, OS X, iOS, Android, and later Nintendo Switch. Windows is the best archive route because it has the strongest capture/display ceiling for the complete episode set and avoids legacy mobile/old-console limits.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current complete Windows release. Verify all five episodes are installed before capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: Verify storefront availability and episode installation because the Telltale catalog has had delisting/relisting history.

entries.title: Borderlands 3
entries.definitive_edition: Borderlands 3 Ultimate Edition content set on Windows

primary.version: Current PC release / Ultimate Edition content set
primary.why: Borderlands 3 shipped on PlayStation 4, Windows, Xbox One, macOS, Stadia, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch. Windows is the best archive route because it has the strongest fidelity/settings/capture ceiling and the current PC build receives the same cross-platform content updates as other platforms.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows version with all campaign add-ons and Director's Cut/Designer content installed if the goal is a complete archive run.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use current update state; Stadia is preserved as a historical release only.

entries.title: Tiny Tina's Wonderlands
entries.definitive_edition: Chaotic Great content set on Windows

primary.version: Current PC release / Chaotic Great content set
primary.why: Tiny Tina's Wonderlands released on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S. Windows is the best archive route because it has the highest capture/settings ceiling and all-platform crossplay/content support, while the Chaotic Great content set is the most complete package route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows version with the Chaotic Great Edition or equivalent content installed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Spin-off sequel to the Dragon Keep DLC, not a numbered Borderlands entry.

entries.title: New Tales from the Borderlands

primary.why: New Tales from the Borderlands released on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S. Windows is the best archive route because it has the highest display/capture ceiling for the complete narrative release.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows release through Steam or Epic.

entries.remaster_caveats: Narrative spin-off successor to Tales from the Borderlands, not a Telltale-developed sequel.

entries.title: Borderlands: Vault Hunter Pinball
entries.definitive_edition: Gearbox Pinball Pack table on Windows

primary.why: Borderlands: Vault Hunter Pinball is a licensed Pinball FX table in the Gearbox Pinball Pack, available across PC and console storefronts. Windows is the best archive route because it has the strongest capture/display ceiling and storefront availability through Steam/Epic.
primary.how_to_play: Use Pinball FX on Windows with the Gearbox Pinball Pack or Borderlands: Vault Hunter Pinball table installed.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a licensed pinball table, not a shooter/RPG Borderlands campaign.

entries.title: Borderlands 4

primary.why: Borderlands 4 released on PlayStation 5, Windows, and Xbox Series X/S in September 2025. Windows is the best archive route because it has the highest fidelity/capture/settings ceiling for the current build; the announced Nintendo Switch 2 version has not been verified as a shipped route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows release through Steam or Epic with post-launch updates installed. Revisit if the delayed Nintendo Switch 2 version receives a final release and any unique features.

entries.remaster_caveats: Post-launch content and the delayed Nintendo Switch 2 route should be revisited as the 2025-2026 update cycle settles.

entries.title: Borderlands Mobile

primary.why: Borderlands Mobile is a limited-time iOS test, not a stable full archive release with final platform coverage.
primary.how_to_play: Do not archive a definitive route until the game has a full release or an official stable test/build history is published.

entries.remaster_caveats: Needs revisit if Zynga/2K publish a full launch, Android route, or end-of-test statement.
